title: Potholes Filled (2018)
description: The Department of Public Works is responsible for filling potholes in the City, both in response to requests from constituents, as well as proactively. A row of data in this dataset is created automatically each time a pothole is filled. GPS units on each Durapatcher truck are signaled when the trigger on the emulsion hose is pulled to begin the filling of a pothole. This dataset was last updated on 07/24/2018. NOTE: Some data from the DuraPatchers is missing because a sensor went down from the beginning of 2018 through February 22, 2018. Data Dictionary: Label Definition TNT_NAME The name of the Tomorrow's Neighborhoods Today area that the pothole is in. activity_type Type of activity in particular direction address Address where potholes were filled date_fixed Date on which potholes were fixed latitude Latitude of the location longitude Longitude of the location repair_type Type of repair truck_name Truck code which carried out the repair Dataset Contact Information: Organization: City of Syracuse Position: Data Program Manager Email: opendata@syr.gov City: Syracuse, NY
match_method: Official DCAT item ID and sublayer resolved through ArcGIS item metadata to the source URL.
